title: Job not accepted (Pending Acceptance)
summary: No driver has taken the job and the pickup window is running out.

n1.q: Which account is the job for?

end: Do not outsource or move it.
Refer the job to Hamyzan immediately.
Post the action in the SG CS Chat.

n2tt.q: Has the outsourcing deadline passed? (afternoon 5pm / evening 7pm)

end: Give it to an agent already heading to the same cluster, zone, postal sector or same seller.
Top up from $1 in steps against the Lalamove price.
Never move a TikTok job to the next day.
Outsource now via the Lalamove API in the Admin portal.
Target: zero Pending Acceptance by 6pm (afternoon) / 7.30pm (evening).
Close the Lalamove job as delivered the same day.
tt_late.esc: Faiq approves afternoon outsourcing; Senior CS evening

end: Top up in $2 steps after auto top-up.
Night: top up until it matches the outsource cost by 8.30pm.
8.25pm: match the Lalamove price for 5–10 mins, notify, push to Urgent; still no taker → Lalamove.
Minmed not accepted by 8.30pm → Lalamove. Never move medical jobs.

n2.q: Is the job movable? (Not bakes/cakes/cooked food, not urgent, not a priority seller)

end: Call drivers en route / use Find a Driver.
Top up in steps if the customer is a priority account (none for low-priority customers).
Still unaccepted at the cut-off (11.45am AM / 4.30–5pm PM): move it to the next slot or day.
Call the buyer, update the seller, log it in the Move-over file.
From 11am match the Lalamove price every 10 mins.
Match Lalamove for 10 mins, send notification, push to Urgent.
Still no taker by 11.45am (AM) / 4.30pm (PM): outsource via the Lalamove API.
Close the Lalamove job the same day.
